name: Mega Darkrai (shiny) (back)
reference_source: package.py: the front config (mega_darkrai_front.json) with the camera turned round (azimuth + 180) and looking down from 12 deg

camera.note: azimuth 112 + style.mirror: the right eye only shows from the model's right-front

motion.note: The game's own battle idle (pm0491_51_00_20001_battlewait01_loop from the user's animation pack, 241 frames at 60 fps = 240 steps = 4.000 s, frame 241 a copy of frame 1), moved onto a copy of the textured model (MegaDarkrai_idle.blend, move_clip.py; rig identical, 249/249 bones, 0 offset, 0 deg, object scale 1). smooth_steps.py eases 7 one-frame rotation pops baked into the clip (horn_a_04, left/right_horn_b_04) over 8 frames. 100 frames x 40 ms = 4.000 s, game speed (every 2.4 game frames; 30 ms would need 133.3 frames).

shiny_note: shiny: colours from the model's shiny textures (make_shiny.py: per-part colour change normal -> shiny, applied to every shade); geometry, motion, lighting and shading decisions identical to mega_darkrai_front.json
